protocol_candidate.design_origin: Exploratory execution-pack defaults plus executor-proposed numerical settings; not claims of user-specified numerical choices

primary.objective: mean simulated net simple return over 60 regular-session minutes after executable entry
primary.decision_grid: every 15 regular-session minutes beginning open+15; stop when full horizon unavailable
primary.entry: next available tradable bar strictly after every input availability timestamp and decision; no same-bar extrema fills
primary.exit: first tradable bar at or after entry+60 regular-session minutes, same session; absent or ambiguous outcome stays missing

protocol_candidate.cohort: Exact accepted M1 slice pinned before outcomes. Aug3 close-selected cohort retrospective before selection availability; investable interpretation begins strictly after evidenced selection availability.

features.lookbacks: Per-feature signed manifest specifying trailing windows and minimum observations; unspecified features excluded. Training-only bins/scaling/imputation and interactions.
features.missingness: No implicit zero; mandatory missing excludes signal with reason retained; optional omitted with reason; labels never imputed.

splits.development: August chronological expanding folds; exact sessions fixed from accepted calendar before evaluation
splits.evaluation: September held out from fitting, conservative retrospective designation until exposure audit proves otherwise
splits.purge: Remove training labels whose full interval overlaps validation/evaluation; per-company embargo at least maximum supported label horizon, up to five sessions for five-session analyses
splits.dependence: Company and session clustered uncertainty; no independent-bar assumption

search.order: canonical feature identifier, predicate operator, training-only threshold identifier; no outcome-informed search extension
search.thresholds: training empirical deciles only, deduplicated and frozen per fold
search.ties: penalized development score descending, fewer predicates, more distinct companies, lexicographic canonical rule
search.all_trials: Retain every evaluated/rejected rule, support denominator, reason, fold and seed

simulation.sizing: hypothetical equal-notional 1000 USD per event; one open position per company, no leverage
simulation.liquidity: entry participation <=1% of evidenced tradable bar dollar volume; if unavailable exclude executable claim
simulation.fills: OHLCV simulation proxy only unless quotes establish spread/executable prices; no queue-priority claim
simulation.position_overlap: new same-company signal ignored until prior exit; log ignored signals

uncertainty.multiple_search: report all trials; selection entirely development; simultaneous or conservative multiplicity-adjusted intervals for retained candidates before robustness claim

protocol_candidate.acceptance: Minimum support, positive multiplicity-adjusted lower 95% net-return bound at primary costs and positive mean at 50bps; report uncertainty/instability and accept no-robust-candidate outcome. No guarantee of profitability.
unresolved_before_freeze: Full applicable instruction and September exposure audit beyond mission protocol-event search
Exact accepted M1 manifest, feature dictionary and calendars
Distinct review of proposed numerical settings and statistical specification
Trusted receipt loader and transactional fenced idempotent dispatch integration
